domains: The immediate institutional strategy is to uphold academic integrity and reinforce accountability through rigorous detection by humans.
Given that the challenges raised by GenAI are complex, researchers and teachers must receive high-quality training and support to do this.
The researcher should develop the ability to verify the information, and be especially capable of detecting citations of non-existent research papers.
